policy: A resource is research-ready only when its source, license, date, SHA-256, CRS, datum/resolution where applicable, and processing history are declared. Demonstration or estimated data never pass silently.

resources.dataset: NIED S-net, DONET1/2 and N-net official station table
resources.license: NIED website and MOWLAS data policy; preserve attribution and verify reuse terms
resources.verticalDatum: Water depth as published by NIED; datum not stated in the table
resources.processing: Deterministic transcription from the official table; coordinates and depths preserved

resources.license: Public domain (attribution requested): GEBCO Compilation Group (2025) GEBCO 2025 Grid (doi:10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29)
resources.processing: GEBCO 2025 (15 arc-second) subset 120-150E/20-50N via CEDA OPeNDAP, block-mean resampled to 0.15°; mixed coastal cells averaged over water samples only to keep ria bays open

resources.dataset: GSI or licensed coastal DEM import slot
resources.license: User must record the applicable GSI terms for the imported dataset
resources.processing: Use import-research-grid and merge-research-grids; no implicit synthetic substitute

resources.license: Project estimates; not the J-SHIS 250 m mesh
resources.processing: Legacy site-factor classes mapped to approximate Vs30 and labelled station-estimate
resources.fallbackReason: Licensed/full J-SHIS 250 m mesh is not bundled

resources.license: K-NET/KiK-net account and data-use terms apply
resources.processing: Use the event-package builder with response removal and surface/borehole pairing

resources.sourceUrl: https://www.data.jma.go.jp/eqev/data/gaikyo/monthly/ (per-record citations in the dataset; JMA 月報 / TTJT unified survey CSV / JMA Sapporo & Cabinet-Office lesson DB)
resources.license: Individual records retain their cited JMA, NOAA/WDS or publication source
resources.verticalDatum: per-record; mixed run-up and tide-gauge values are never merged without type labels
resources.processing: Direct curation v2 (R5-6): every observation and forecast-area row cites its primary record (JMA monthly tide tables parsed at char-coordinate level, TTJT reliability-A survey rows, JMA Sapporo / Cabinet-Office 1993 pages); station coordinates from the JMA tide-table station list. Builder: tools/build-tsunami-observations.js; frozen extracts: tools/data/tsunami-jma-monthly-records.json

resources.dataset: J-SHIS 2020 表層地盤 AVS30 (Z-WM2020-JAPAN-M250) block-averaged 0.05° derived grid
resources.license: J-SHIS利用規約 (https://www.j-shis.bosai.go.jp/agreement) — processed derivative permitted under 5.1; cite J-SHIS/NIED on republication
resources.processing: tools/build-vs30-grid.js block average of the J-SHIS 250 m AVS30 mesh (17,848 land cells); original raster not redistributed

resources.dataset: K-NET/KiK-net observed station peaks (13 events, 2,626 stations frozen) via USGS Shakemap stationlist exports
resources.license: USGS Shakemap products (public domain); station data © NIED K-NET/KiK-net (DOI 10.17598/NIED.0004) — derived peak values only, cite NIED
resources.processing: tools/fetch-strong-motion-obs.js per-event stationlist downloads, peak PGA/PGV/intensity extraction; intensity values are GMICE-converted MMI (not JMA instrumental intensity)

resources.dataset: USGS ComCat Japan-region catalog (M>=5.0 since 1923) reduced to a smoothed gridded GR + scenario PSHA source model
resources.license: USGS public domain (ComCat); scenario rates cite Earthquake Research Committee published 30-year probabilities
resources.resolution: 0.25 degree gridded sources + finite-fault scenario patches
resources.processing: tools/fetch-comcat-japan.js (frozen catalog) + tools/build-psha-source-model.js (decluster, completeness scan, adaptive top-hat smoothing with per-class mass renormalisation, Aki b); simplified self-computed model, NOT the official J-SHIS source model

resources.dataset: GEBCO 2025 Grid (Chile megathrust margin 19S-46S, 0.05° water-mean resample)
resources.license: Public domain (attribution requested): GEBCO Compilation Group (2025) GEBCO 2025 Grid (doi:10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29)
resources.processing: GEBCO 2025 (15 arc-second) subset 76.5-69W/17.5-46S via CEDA OPeNDAP, 3x3 point-sample water-mean per 0.05° cell (country-scale strip: integer nested ratio 3 over the 0.15° global grid, solver cost comparable to the 0.025° Japan patches)

resources.dataset: GEBCO 2025 Grid (Messina Strait / NE Sicily / S Calabria, 0.025° water-mean resample)
resources.license: Public domain (attribution requested): GEBCO Compilation Group (2025) GEBCO 2025 Grid (doi:10.5285/37c52e96-24ea-67ce-e063-7086abc05f29)
resources.processing: GEBCO 2025 (15 arc-second) subset 15-16.3E/37.7-38.5N via CEDA OPeNDAP, 3x3 point-sample water-mean per 0.025° cell (1908 Messina tsunami demonstration box)

resources.dataset: USGS Global Vs30 hybrid (Heath et al. 2020), Italy, 0.025° block-mean resample
resources.license: USGS public domain; assembly repo CC0 1.0 (github.com/usgs/earthquake-global_vs30)
resources.processing: assembled global product (apps.usgs.gov global_vs30.grd, incl. geology-based Italy inset) block-mean 3x3 valid pixels per 0.025° cell; exact-600 ocean fill cells confirmed water by a GEBCO mask zeroed to nodata

resources.dataset: USGS Global Vs30 hybrid (Heath et al. 2020), Chile, 0.025° block-mean resample
resources.license: USGS public domain; assembly repo CC0 1.0 (github.com/usgs/earthquake-global_vs30)
resources.processing: assembled global product (apps.usgs.gov global_vs30.grd, slope-based default) block-mean 3x3 valid pixels per 0.025° cell; exact-600 ocean fill cells confirmed water by a GEBCO mask zeroed to nodata
